<script>
    window.addEventListener('skiptohead', (event) => {
        window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    });
    window.addEventListener('skipLink', (event) => {
       const mainContent = document.getElementsByClassName('mainContent')[0];
     //   console.log('event dispatched skipLink------------', mainContent);
        if(mainContent){
            mainContent.tabIndex=-1;
            mainContent.focus();
        //    console.log('event dispatchedss------------', mainContent);
        }
       const skipLink= document.getElementsByClassName('skipToBtn');
        if(skipLink){
            skipLink.style.display=none;
        }
    //     console.log('event dispatched skipLink------------', skipLink);
    });
    window.addEventListener('load', (event) => {  
        let arrayEle = document.getElementsByClassName('siteforceLoadingBalls');
        for (let i = 0; i < arrayEle.length; i++ ) {
            console.log("loading balls: " + arrayEle[i]);
            arrayEle[i].setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
            arrayEle[i].setAttribute("aria-label", "loading");
            arrayEle[i].setAttribute("role", "status");
        } 
    });
    
    window.addEventListener('category', (event) => { 
        //console.log("category title--------", event.detail);
        document.title = event.detail + " category search page";
        if(document.getElementById('categoryPageTitle')){
            document.getElementById('categoryPageTitle').remove();
        }
		var elemDiv = document.createElement('div');
		elemDiv.setAttribute('class', 'slds-assistive-text');
        elemDiv.setAttribute('id', 'categoryPageTitle');
		elemDiv.setAttribute('tabIndex', '0');
        elemDiv.innerHTML = "loading " + event.detail + " category search page";
		document.body.insertBefore(elemDiv, document.body.children[0]);
		document.getElementById('categoryPageTitle').focus();
    });
    setTimeout(()=> {
	console.log('delay added 2');
	console.log(document.getElementById('gtag'));
	var t = 'Optanon.TriggerGoogleAnalyticsEvent('
	var g = "\'OneTrust Cookie Consent\'";
	var d = ',';
	var l = "\'Banner Open Preferences\'";
	var p = ')';
	console.log(t+g+d+l+p);
	var full = t+g+d+l+p;
	document.getElementById('gtag').setAttribute('onclick',full);
},20000);
</script>
